# Summary

Explain the change and link the relevant issue or design discussion.

## Scope and behavior

Identify affected shared VBE services, host adapters, providers, UI or documentation.
Call out user-visible changes, migrations and known limitations.

## Validation

List exact commands, source/build identity and results. Separate local tests,
coverage, Designer/runtime checks, native-host tests and authenticated providers.
Explicitly list checks not run. Do not equate simulated COM with real-host coverage.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Project scope, approval, revision and recovery guards remain intact.
- [ ] No credentials, private VBA content or machine-specific artifacts are included.
- [ ] COM identities, host-thread ownership and existing data are preserved.
- [ ] Relevant guides and the changelog describe the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No installer, release publication or license change is implied unintentionally.

Mark items that do not apply and explain why. AI-assisted changes remain the
contributor's responsibility to review and validate.
